findings.title: The 'no old wording written into a main checkout' half of AC1 is enforced only once slice 09 lands
findings.detail:
A grep of the unit and e2e tiers finds no old-wording YAML written into .agents/workflows outside the deliberate cases. Nothing fails today if one comes back, because the loader still accepts old wording in the main checkout. This is expected under the expand-contract plan, and the handoff already lists it under Not proven yet.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None for this slice; slice 09's refusal makes the tiers enforce it.
